item.title: AP women's basketball player of the week is No. 9 Iowa's Ava Heiden
item.description: The Associated Press national player of the week in women’s basketball for Week 16 of the season: Ava Heiden. The sophomore center led No. 9 Iowa to wins over Nebraska, Purdue and Michigan last week, recording a double-double in each of the games. She had 24 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks in a win over then-No. 6 Michigan. [...]
